payload.title: Run live round 1 for F and F-rand and take the first reading (S1)
payload.description:
## Purpose

Run live round 1 for F and F-rand on Jev and take the first F vs F-rand reading (stop S1).

## Scope

Round 1 (100 labels) on dev-100: F's 3-trial search plus fill, and F-rand. A-c / A-c+F zero-shot work waits for L2 comments (Phase 2); design §5.3 lists them in round 1, the owner's phasing moves them. No paper-600.

## Cost cap

≈600 few-shot requests, ≈$0.40–0.55 (Appendix C rates); **hard cap 1,000 Jev requests** for this step inside the 7,500 cumulative ledger. Pre-approved by the owner within these caps.

## Definition of done (S1)

Requests well-formed; F's list differs from F-rand's; few-shot answers differ from zero-shot on about 20% of items; token multiplier about 1.9×; dev-100 F vs F-rand accuracy/Brier and actual spend posted as a comment; humans look before Phase 2 spend.

## Design

[DECISION_FLYWHEEL_DESIGN.md](https://github.com/AnthusAI/Decision-Flywheel-Evaluations/blob/main/studies/DECISION_FLYWHEEL_DESIGN.md) §3.2, §5.3, §6 step 5.
